etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 兼 (phonetic ケン→かま) — the curved reaping blade: sickle.
mnemonic: The blade that gathers as it cuts — かま. 鎌倉: the sickle-storehouse city.

etymology: Compound ideograph: stalks crossed (メ) under the blade (刂) — mowing: to reap, trim.
mnemonic: X marks the swath — かる. 芝刈り: the lawn's haircut.

etymology: Compound: a hand (寸) setting the cover (冖) on the head (元) — the coming-of-age capping: crown.
mnemonic: Hand places the circle on the first head — かんむり. 王冠: the bottle cap kept its dignity.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 甚 (phonetic カン) + 力 — the effort of weighing things — done so often it becomes instinct: intuition.
mnemonic: Calculation compressed into a hunch — カン. 勘がいい: the auditor who guesses right.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 雚 (phonetic カン) + 力 — effort applied to another's will: to urge, recommend.
mnemonic: The friendly push toward the door — すすめる. 勧誘: persuasion with pamphlets.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 奐 (phonetic カン) — the summoning cry: to call out, summon (to court).
mnemonic: The bailiff's shout down the corridor — カン. 召喚: summoned, in games and law alike.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 甚 (phonetic カン) — ground that bears the load: to endure.
mnemonic: Soil that holds under anything — たえる. 堪忍: patience, load-tested.

etymology: Compound: a spacious house (宀) with room to overlook faults: generous, lenient.
mnemonic: A roof wide enough for everyone's flaws — カン. 寛容: the roomy heart.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 串 'skewer' (phonetic カン) + heart (心) — the heart run through: illness, affliction.
mnemonic: Worry on a skewer through the chest — カン. 患者: the one the skewer chose.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 感 (phonetic カン) — feeling that stays lodged: regret.
mnemonic: 感 with a splinter left in — カン. 遺憾: diplomacy's 'deep regret'.

etymology: Compound: grasping and striking regardless — venturing boldly: daring.
mnemonic: Swinging first, calculating later — あえて. 敢えて: doing it anyway, on purpose.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 官 (phonetic カン) — the final wooden housing: coffin.
mnemonic: The last官舎 (official residence) — カン. 棺: administration's endpoint.

etymology: Compound: sincere address before the altar — cordiality; the inscribed clauses of it: articles (of a contract).
mnemonic: Warm words, then the fine print — カン. 定款: the company's founding clauses.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 雚 (phonetic カン) + 欠 'open mouth' — joy voiced aloud: delight.
mnemonic: The cheer that opens every throat — カン. 歓迎会: delight, catered.

etymology: Compound: the bowed eye (臣) checking its reflection in the water dish (皿) — inspection from above: to oversee.
mnemonic: The supervisor's eye in every mirror — カン. 監督: the film director; 監視: the cameras.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 爰 (phonetic カン) — the rope let out: slack, gentle, gradual.
mnemonic: Tension released a hand at a time — ゆるい. 緩和: the loosening, policy-grade.

etymology: Pictograph: an ancient clay jar — recycled in modern times for the tin can.
mnemonic: The jar that went industrial — カン. 缶コーヒー: the vending machine's clay pot.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 干 (phonetic カン) — the vital organ of courage: liver; nerve, the essential point (肝心).
mnemonic: Where the old anatomy stored your nerve — きも. 肝心: liver-and-heart important.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ship (舟) + 監 (phonetic カン) — the armored overseeing vessel: warship.
mnemonic: The boat with a supervisor and cannons — カン. 軍艦: the navy's kanji.

etymology: Compound ideograph: coins (貝) strung on a cord — run straight through: to pierce, carry through.
mnemonic: One string through every coin — つらぬく. 貫く: holding your line through everything.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 瞏 (phonetic カン) — the full circle home: to return, restore.
mnemonic: The long loop that ends at the start — カン. 返還, 還暦: giving back, and the 60-year loop.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 監 (phonetic カン) — the bronze mirror one checks against: model, connoisseurship (鑑定).
mnemonic: The reference mirror for judging the real thing — かんがみる. 図鑑: the specimen book — your Kanjidex's namesake.

etymology: Compound: a tree (木) grown in the gateway (門) — traffic long gone: idle, quiet.
mnemonic: So few visitors a tree took the doorway — カン. 閑静: real-estate-listing quiet.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 臽 'pit' (phonetic カン) — ground giving way: to cave in, fall into.
mnemonic: The hillside opens and takes the road with it — おちいる. 欠陥: the flaw you fall through.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 元 (phonetic ガン) + head (頁) — a head set hard: obstinate.
mnemonic: The skull that won't update — ガン. 頑張る: stubbornness, weaponized for good.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a person on tiptoe (止) peering ahead — reaching for what's next: to plan, undertake.
mnemonic: On tiptoes, eyeing the opportunity — くわだてる. 企業, 企画: tiptoe institutionalized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 支 (phonetic ギ/キ) — performed skill: artistry — the 伎 of 歌舞伎.
mnemonic: 技's stage twin — キ. 歌舞伎: song, dance, skill.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 大 + 可 (phonetic キ) — the improbably big: odd, wondrous; odd numbers (奇数).
mnemonic: 'That big? Surely not' — キ. 奇跡 wonders; 奇数 just refuses to pair.

etymology: Compound: fine threads by the guard's blade — barely perceptible: how many? how much? (幾つ).
mnemonic: Counting threads at the checkpoint — いくつ. 幾ら: the eternal market question.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 己 (phonetic キ) + heart (心) — what the heart shuns: taboo; the shunned days: mourning.
mnemonic: The date the heart circles in black — いむ. 一周忌: the first year's return.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the diner turning from the finished meal — done: already.
mnemonic: Plate empty, face turned away — すでに. 既に: too late, it happened.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 其 (phonetic キ) — the wooden game piece: shōgi, go.
mnemonic: Wood carved into strategy — キ. 将棋: the general's board.

etymology: Compound (grim origin): a winnowing basket carrying away an infant — to discard: abandon.
mnemonic: Carried out with the chaff — すてる's cold cousin, キ. 放棄, 棄権: rights and races, dropped.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 九 (phonetic キ) — the wheel's worn groove: track, orbit.
mnemonic: Where every cart before you went — キ. 軌道: orbit — the sky's wheel-rut.

etymology: Phono-semantic: light (光) + 軍 (phonetic キ) — light in full force: to shine, sparkle.
mnemonic: An army of light — かがやく. 輝く: stars, trophies, eyes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 几 (phonetic キ) — the empty table: hunger, famine.
mnemonic: A table with nothing on it — うえる. 飢餓: the empty-table pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — mounted astride: riding; the counter for horsemen.
mnemonic: One rider, one horse, counted together — キ. 騎士: the knight kanji.

etymology: Pictograph: a spirit with a monstrous head — the dead returned: ghost, ogre.
mnemonic: The big-headed visitor from the other side — おに. 鬼ごっこ: tag, with a demon 'it'.

etymology: Pictograph: a turtle — head, shell segments, tail — whose heated shells gave the first oracle cracks.
mnemonic: The animal whose back invented divination — かめ. 亀: slow, sacred, still recognizable.

etymology: Compound: person (亻) + 為 'made' — man-made rather than genuine: fake, false.
mnemonic: Done (為) by someone, passed off as real — にせ. 偽物: the flea-market warning.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 義 (phonetic ギ) — righteousness embodied in form: ceremony, etiquette, apparatus.
mnemonic: Righteousness with a dress code — ギ. 儀式 and 地球儀: rites, and the globe on your desk.

etymology: Compound: offerings properly stacked (且) under the roof — fitting, appropriate.
mnemonic: Everything arranged as it should be — ギ. 宜しく: 'appropriately, please' — Japan's universal handshake.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 戈 — mock combat: play, jest, drama (戯曲).
mnemonic: Swordplay with the edges off — たわむれる. 悪戯: mischief, いたずら.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 疑 (phonetic ギ) — made to resemble until you doubt: to imitate, simulate.
mnemonic: A copy good enough to raise 疑 — ギ. 擬音語: sound-mimicking words — ワンワン, ドキドキ.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 其 (phonetic ギ) + 欠 — words breathed to mislead: to deceive.
mnemonic: The open mouth selling the empty basket — あざむく. 詐欺: fraud's formal name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ox (牛) + 義 (phonetic ギ) — the flawless beast given up: sacrifice.
mnemonic: The best of the herd, for the greater claim — ギ. 犠牲: what the plan cost.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 匊 (phonetic キク) — the imperial bloom: chrysanthemum.
mnemonic: Petals packed like grains in a fist — キク. 菊: on passports and November altars.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the gentleman's (士) word (口) — auspicious speech: good fortune.
mnemonic: The fortune slip you hoped for — キチ. 大吉: the shrine's jackpot.
